name: roadmap
description: Coordinate from one agreed roadmap.json across three orchestration levels (program, epic lead, worker), with a kickoff question for model, effort and parallel epics, a standalone HTML timeline, epic ownership and handoffs, conditional Orca operating guidance, read-only drift reporting, and dry-run-first publishing to GitLab, GitHub or Forgejo. The tool never deletes and closes only its own drift issue. Includes a merge request check, scheduled drift reporting and Claude Code hooks, run through uv when it is installed. Start with the roadmap skill.
